entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely the wrong size! This is unacceptable. I've spent thousands with you people.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear it's not fitting right. To pull up your order, could I get your name and order number please?
The name is Alex Chen. Order number is VF-8675309. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. The jersey is just way too tight. I need to get an exchange or my money back immediately.

I understand completely, Alex. Thank you for that. I'm pulling up your order now. And just to clarify for my notes, is the issue a preference on the fit, or do you believe there's a manufacturing defect with the sizing?

What kind of a stupid question is that? It's too tight! I ordered a Large, it fits like a Small! I want to talk to your manager, right now. This is ridiculous. I'll be sure to post about this on every cycling forum I'm on.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager, I can absolutely resolve this for you right now. I see you're a VIP member with us, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. I sincerely apologize that the sizing was so off on this jersey.
Looking at your order, you received it 22 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy. We can definitely process this.
Of course it's within the policy. So what are you going to do? Don't tell me I have to pay to ship this back.

Not at all. I've just emailed you a pre-paid return label. We can either send you the next size up for an exchange, or I can issue a full refund to your original payment method. Whichever you prefer. For the inconvenience with the wrong size, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next order.
Oh. A credit? Fine. That's better. Send the exchange. I want the XL. Just make sure you get it right this time.

Absolutely. I've just processed the exchange for the Pro-Series jersey in size XL. It will ship out as soon as the carrier scans your return package. The return label and all the details are in your email now. Is there anything else I can assist you with, Alex?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
